title: Zoning text change requiring affordable units at 132 Melrose Street
summary: This resolution approves, with modifications, a zoning text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 132-136 Melrose Street in Bushwick, Brooklyn. Combined with a related zoning map change, it would enable a new six-story, about 24,600-square-foot mixed-use building with 18 apartments, five of them permanently income-restricted, and 6,000 square feet of ground-floor commercial space. The Council found no significant environmental impact based on a Revised Negative Declaration issued September 21, 2026.
